about: Sign-offs for the release gate (edakit gate). Each one counts only for the hash of its scope: 'circuit' = state_sha256 (graph, parts database, simulation config), 'layout' = layout_sha256 (layout files, footprint geometry). When something there changes, it no longer counts – copy the new hash from the protocol header after the check was repeated. phase: 'export' blocks the release, 'order' and 'acceptance' come after the export. An accepted warning with scope 'decision' counts regardless of the hash and refers to a numbered decision in the docs. Parts are signed in their parts entry (field 'verified').

manual.text: Critical parts (U1 T-Display pinout and the project-library footprint, C1 polarity, the 0805 LEDs' polarity, J1 servo pinout) checked a second time independently against datasheet and footprint – e.g. by the agent electrical-reviewer
manual.note: OK for state 369afd68… (review of bc51d69e…, gate run 20261026-114808, then the corrected C17408 text and R8/R9 notes confirmed): U1 pins 1–24 = LILYGO pin map = schematic P4/P5 = KiCad/Eagle; 24 × Ø1.10 mm, rows Y 16.57/39.43 (22.86 mm), pitch 2.54, pins 1/13 square at the USB edge, 5V row at the front, copper traced from the Gerber files; ESP32 levels (buttons 3V3 on input-only IO38/IO37, strapping pins free), LEDs 7.3–11.4 mA, D2 1N5819 476 mA in the bell phase; C1 + at pad 1; LED cathodes at pad 2; J1 1 GND / 2 +5V / 3 SIG. Notes: the module's USB-C has one CC pull-down only (C-to-C works in one plug orientation); a stalled servo loads D2 with 87 % of 1 A – the firmware port must detach the servo at rest; check the U1 drill pattern again after the Import Changes click; the module fits turned by 180° (silkscreen 5V mark).

manual.text: Layout reviewed independently (manufacturability; mechanics: USB at the edge; operation of the buttons; looks of the LED row) on the manufacturing files of a gate run – e.g. by the agent pcb-reviewer
manual.note: OK for layout hash 4e836f8e… (gate run 20261026-123051, gerber_esp32.zip 830878448e1e…; the first review of e65f87a7… was NOT OK: LED-row detours with six vias and no order-number placeholder – fixed with fixed anode tracks, chevron keep-outs, JLCJLCJLCJLC under the module, U1 texts 1.5 mm, USB box inside the board, '5V' at U1.1): smallest gap 0.205 mm, copper 0.5 mm from the edge, header rings 0.30 mm, vias tented, paste on all 41 SMD pads and none on U1, U1 = LILYGO's KiCad footprint (rows 22.86 mm, pin 1 15.93 mm from the USB end), no silk outside the board, footprint name not printed. Notes: +5V through one 0.3 mm via (0.47 A in operation, the stall case is information only, D-3/D-13); three tented vias and a pour gap near R7/S1 (functional area). Condition: after the Import Changes click the release run's Gerber and drill files must equal this run's (apart from G04 headers), otherwise check again.

manual.text: At JLCPCB after the upload: assembly preview (LEDs, C1, J1, buttons, resistors), BOM without missing parts, price
Acceptance of every delivered board: visual check, T-Display plugged in, current through USB, every LED, both buttons, the servo swings, the display shows the countdown
